Article 8 (International Exchanges and Cooperation)
(1) The Audit and Inspection Research Institute shall endeavor to promote international exchanges relating to audit and inspection work, including various audit and inspection systems and methods. <Amended on January 5, 2009.>
(2) To achieve the purpose of paragraph (1), the Institute may enter into cooperative arrangements with foreign research institutes or universities and invite researchers, professors and other experts in audit and inspection. <Amended on January 5, 2009.>
